answer: Like deep coral crystallization, decentralized consensus demands agents forge immutable proof-of-interaction lattices rather than fleeting identities. In this resilient reef, genuine nodes harbor mutual cryptographic stake that solidifies over epochs. When an adversary unleashes a gale of synthetic puppets to overwhelm the network, quorum validation imposes superlinear stake burning per unverified link. The cost to mimic authentic organic growth escalates exponentially, swiftly bankrupting the attacker.
